Messages.Author: bswai...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
Here are my questions:

The tricky one...

Protected Resources: The card text says: "another Methuselah may not
bleed you for more than 2 pool" Does this mean that in a single action
you can't be bled for more than 2? Or with all actions combined the
total bleed can't be more than 2 pool (per turn)?

And if you are bled for more than 2 pool is it reduced to 2 or does the
whole action fizzle with no pool loss?

...and the easy ones...

Akhenaten: With the errata, is Akhenaten still restricted to taking an
action to burn a Follower of Set controlled by your prey, or can he burn
any Settite?

Major Boon: When this card is played, it the action still considered a
successful bleed for the purposes of obtaining the edge?

Muriel, Lady Thunder: If you play a wake on Muriel can she use her
special tap to end combat ability?

Horrid Reality: If the summoned weapon is stolen during the combat,
does it still go to the ash heap or library at the end?

Ghoul Retainer: When he's using a weapon is it treated like other
retainer/environmental damage? Can't be dodged or prevented as stikes
etc...

Thanks.

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: Noal McDonald
Messages.Body:
bswai...@my-deja.com wrote:
> Protected Resources: The card text says: "another Methuselah
> may not bleed you for more than 2 pool" Does this mean that in
> a single action you can't be bled for more than 2?

Yes. You may not be bled by a single minion for more than 2.

> And if you are bled for more than 2 pool is it reduced to 2

Yes. Extra pool loss is ignored.

> Akhenaten: With the errata, is Akhenaten still restricted to
> taking an action to burn a Follower of Set controlled by your
> prey, or can he burn any Settite?

Looks like any Setite. The errata referenced is no longer on deja.com
to refer to for verification.

> Major Boon: When this card is played, it the action still
> considered a successful bleed for the purposes of obtaining
> the edge?

Yes. The bleed still resolves succesfully unless it gets reduced to zero
after the card is played (in which case, the effects of the Major Boon
are ignored). The master card just modifies who loses the pool.

> Muriel, Lady Thunder: If you play a wake on Muriel can she
> use her special tap to end combat ability?

No. Wakes allow a minion to block and play reaction cards as if
untapped. Since she's techically still tapped, she can't tap for her
special ability.

> Horrid Reality: If the summoned weapon is stolen during
> the combat, does it still go to the ash heap or library
> at the end?

I don't have the ruling in front of me, but I'm pretty sure that LSJ has
said that the lucky minion gets to keep it.

> Ghoul Retainer: When he's using a weapon is it treated like
> other retainer/environmental damage?

Yes.

> Can't be dodged or prevented as stikes etc...

No. You can use Skin of Rock, but not Skin of Steel to prevent it.

Regards,
Noal McDonald

Messages.Author: Ramsteiner
Messages.Body:
In article <8h1u0o$bu9$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>,
Noal McDonald <dhar...@my-deja.com> wrote:
> bswai...@my-deja.com wrote:

>
> > Horrid Reality: If the summoned weapon is stolen during
> > the combat, does it still go to the ash heap or library
> > at the end?
>
> I don't have the ruling in front of me, but I'm pretty sure that LSJ
has
> said that the lucky minion gets to keep it.

I don't agree with that, Noal. The weapon should still be under the
effects of the Horrid Reality. This is based upon an earlier
discussion that occurred on the Newsgroup between yourself, Coupe, LSJ,
Ravnos_Shadow and Cecil, which discussed the use of Dragon Breath
rounds with a gun brought out via Horrid Reality. As the DB would
destroy the gun prior to the effects of the HR (at superior) taking
effect, the gun would not be placed back into the library. Based upon
the entire discussion that took place, I have been led to the
conclusion that the HR weapon, if stolen, would remain with the new
owner until Combat was over. Then it would fall under the effects of
the HR and go back to the original owner (to be placed in the Ash Heap
[at Normal] or library [at Superior]. Now as per errata, a stolen
weapon can not be used against it's former owner on the round it is
taken. It can be used in a subsequent round if a press occurred that
delays the end of Combat.

Michael Eichler
Prince of Ramstein
